doc.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Multi-bass arrangement of Freddie Hubbard's Little Sunflower
summary: On the new record he overdubbed four acoustic basses and electric bass with Mino Cinelu on percussion.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: That’s fabulous. You are doing one of his tunes on your next record, right?

That’s right. “Little Sunflower.” And not only because it’s a great tune but the way I did it on the album, it’s a little different. I did these multi-layering and overdubs so when you hear “Little Sunflower” you hear four acoustic basses and one electric bass and Mino Cinelu is playing percussion, and I just thought that “Little Sunflower” would be a perfect song to lend itself for bass and percussion, and I hope Freddie likes it.
I’m sure he will. I think I know what he likes and what he doesn’t.
